description: This file defines ASN.1 XNAP protocol structures, including message types, procedures, and classes for encoding/decoding ASN.1 messages related to 3GPP TS ASN1 specifications. It includes class definitions for different message procedures, their serialization, and handling of protocol elements within the 'asn1::xnap' namespace.

classes.name: xnap::init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 InitiatingMessage with protocol code, criticality, and procedure value.

classes.name: xnap::successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 SuccessfulOutcome with protocol code, criticality, and procedure value.

classes.name: xnap::unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 UnsuccessfulOutcome with protocol code, criticality, and procedure value.

classes.name: xnap::xnap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Defines the set of ASN.1 elementary procedures, including initiation, success, and failure messages.

classes.name: xnap::xnap_elem_procs_class_1_o
classes.description: Defines ASN.1 procedures for class 1, including various request and response message types.

classes.name: xnap::xnap_elem_procs_class_2_o
classes.description: Defines ASN.1 procedures for class 2, including additional message types like paging, release, and transfer.

classes.name: xnap::xn_ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 XNAP Protocol Data Unit as a choice of initiation, success, or failure message.

methods.name: get_init_msg
methods.description: Retrieves the initiation message structure based on protocol code.

methods.name: get_successful_outcome
methods.description: Retrieves the successful outcome message structure based on protocol code.

methods.name: get_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Retrieves the unsuccessful outcome message structure based on protocol code.

methods.name: get_crit
methods.description: Gets the criticality enumeration for a given protocol code.
